newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cricket-Rhodes and Kallis recalled to S.A. squad.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Rhodes and Kallis recalled to S.A. squad.

text.p: Livewire batsman and fielder Jonty Rhodes and all-rounder Jacques Kallis were both recalled to the 12-man South African squad announced on Saturday for next week's first test against Australia in Johannesburg.
Rhodes, who last played a test against India at Ahmedabad last November, is "an important asset to the side for his fielding alone", said convenor of selectors Peter Pollock in naming the squad.
